notes.title: Devlog update: Offices in the Shadows
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A quick reminder: if you haven't already, please wishlist《工廈 Warehouse》on Steam — it really helps a lot for a solo indie developer like me!

Wishlist here!
🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3656990/_Warehouse/]Warehouse 工廈[/url]

This week’s update:

[previewyoutube=zUPQw5lxZMU;full][/previewyoutube]

I've finished blocking out two new units for Level 2 — office-style rooms hidden inside the industrial building.
In real-life Hong Kong, many old factory spaces are turned into messy, eclectic offices because of cheaper rent. I wanted to capture that atmosphere: worn-out desks, scattered paperwork, and a lingering feeling that the people here left... but not everything did.

You’ll notice three of the office rooms share similar, slightly varied decorations — a glimpse into the strange normalcy that existed before everything fell apart.

Only two more units left to decorate for this level.
After that, I’ll start building out the overall level flow and gameplay structure!

If you're curious about the journey so far, check out previous development posts on:
🔗 [url=https://www.instagram.com/echo_studio_games/]Instagram[/url]
🔗 [url=https://x.com/EchoStudio_HK]X/Twitter[/url]

I also created a new social media account on TikTok, and you can check out some short videos there, too!
🔗[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@echo_studio_game?_t=ZS-8vukINib3No&_r=1]TikTok[/url]

☕ You can also support the project here:
🔗 [url=https://ko-fi.com/echostudiogames]https://ko-fi.com/echostudiogames
[/url]

Thank you for following the journey!
